rules.text: You can return items within 30 days of purchase or receipt.
rules.quote: If you don't, send it back within 30 days.

rules.text: You can exchange items within 30 days and the exchange shipping is free.
rules.quote: Need the same item in a different size or color? We'll ship your exchange for free.

rules.text: Refunds are processed after the returned item is received using the label on the packing slip.
rules.quote: Apply the label that came on your packing slip to the outside of the package.

rules.text: Return shipping is free and you can leave the package in your mailbox or drop it off at a Post Office or UPS location.
rules.quote: Leave it in your mailbox or drop it off at a Post Office or UPS location.
